name: Hircine's Harlots - Kylara's Fate
source:
In Kylara's Fate you play as Kylara, an Ayleid woman, an outcast of her Ayleid tribe in Skyrim.
She was just enjoying life with her troll companion, Binoh, when everything went wrong.

Play through her journey as she unknowingly plays her role chosen by the god she's most devoted to, Hircine. Hircine has great plans for Kylara and with the aid of his followers, he will change Skyrim and the world forever...

[From F95Zone]
translation:
在《Kylara's Fate》中，你将扮演凯拉拉，一位被天际的亚历德部族放逐的亚历德女性。
她原本正与巨魔伙伴比诺一起享受生活，一切却突然急转直下。

踏上她的旅程，见证她如何在不知情的情况下，扮演自己最虔诚崇奉的神祇海尔辛为她选定的角色。海尔辛对凯拉拉有着宏大的安排，并将在信徒们的帮助下，永远改变天际与整个世界……

[摘自F95Zone]
